odette.text: Keeps the general store in Hearthwell, where seeds and everyday goods are sold. Lives above the shop with Dorrie and Fitch.

dorrie.text: Odette's partner. Helps keep the household and the general store running.

fitch.text: The store keeper's child, growing up among the shelves and the village square.

alder.text: The village gardener. Tends the beds around Hearthwell and knows the soil better than anyone.

bramwell.text: The village smith. Sells tools and metalwork from the smithy.

hattie.text: Runs the inn at the heart of the village, where the evening crowd gathers.

podge.text: Hattie's partner, who shares the work of the inn and its kitchen.

pim.text: The inn keepers' child, who knows every guest and every corner of the inn.

aurelle.text: The healer. Keeps a small clinic for those who come back from the mines worse for wear.

dunmar.text: The librarian. Looks after the village library and its collection of old books.

tilda.text: The carpenter. Runs the sawmill, builds and upgrades buildings, and sells timber.

rufus.text: Tilda's partner, who works beside the carpenter at the sawmill.

wren.text: The carpenter's child, often found around the sawmill among the wood shavings.

cuthbert.text: The reeve, who is also steward of the village hall and keeper of the post. Tracks the hall's community projects.

cordelia.text: The village hat-maker, with a shop full of hats for every season and festival.

barnaby.text: Cordelia's sibling, who lives and works at the hatter's shop.

linnet.text: A young adult from the village who works at the inn.

thistle.text: A young adult from the village who works at the inn.

hester.text: A retired villager who has seen many seasons come and go in the valley, and lives with Walter and their grandchild Toby.

walter.text: A retired villager who shares a home with Hester and their grandchild Toby.

toby.text: Hester and Walter's grandchild, who spends the days running about Hearthwell.

dilly.text: Keeps animals on the farmstead in the forest.

rosmarin.text: A hermit witch who lives in a tower deep in the forest and keeps to herself.

rundahl.text: An old wanderer who makes camp in the forest and knows its paths.

korvi.text: A dwarf smith who works a forge high on the mountain.

marl.text: A dwarf who keeps the quarry and its stone.

maren.text: Trains fighters at the hall by the mines and knows what waits below.

rushie.text: A fisher who lives on the river delta and sells fishing gear from a hut.

thalwen.text: A sea elf who lives in a cottage on the beach and keeps a stall there.

aldreth.text: A courier who lodges at the inn and carries letters across the valley.
